seeker_flawed_plan: Aksel plans to test the backup power system by simply unplugging the tower's main AC power during regular broadcasting hours and timing how long the batteries keep the equipment running.
flaw_explanation: Unplugging under live load means the test measures battery capacity under real-time demand, but Aksel assumes the batteries are fully charged and healthy; if they are partially degraded or not fully charged, the test will underestimate runtime and could interrupt the broadcast mid-test. A proper test would first verify charge state or use a controlled load rather than the live transmitter.
